scope.reason: Replay reads the stored source envelope and document objects through the ingestion parser, verifying each recorded digest and length; parser output is unchanged and the parsed decision has no feature storage of its own. Revalidate deferred stored PDF payloads through the shared typed corpus-validation result; invalid textless structure is a classified no-document outcome, while readable source text and AST retain the same parser. Preserve PDF paragraph gaps, lettered items and the bounded first-page metadata table when rebuilding document text and block boundaries from captured PDF bytes. Rows without captured PDF bytes yield a metadata-only replay outcome and retain their applied parser version; populated historical rows require an explicit PDF capture refresh. Metadata-derived titles require extracted document blocks. Paragraph-gap thresholds derive from font metrics rather than the frequency of observed gaps.
